# FileUpload { #anylumino.FileUpload }

```python
FileUpload(
    accept='',
    multiple=False,
    disabled=False,
    description='Upload',
    icon='upload',
    icon_family='classic',
    icon_variant='solid',
    icon_library='default',
)
```

File upload control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type     | Description                                                         | Default     |
|--------------|----------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| accept | optional | Accepted file extensions or MIME types. | `''` |
| multiple | optional | Whether multiple files can be selected. | `False` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `'Upload'` |
| icon | optional | Web Awesome icon name. | `'upload'` |
| icon_family | optional | Web Awesome icon family, for example ``'classic'``. | `'classic'` |
| icon_variant | optional | Web Awesome icon variant, for example ``'solid'`` or ``'regular'``. | `'solid'` |
| icon_library | optional | Web Awesome icon library, for example ``'default'``. | `'default'` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.FileUpload.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
